summary: The app largely follows the DESIGN.md specification – all listed screens exist, the component library is built on React‑Native‑Paper, themes and spacing tokens are used, and there are no accessibility violations reported by axe. Lighthouse scores are high for accessibility and best practices. However the primary user flow is broken because the "History" button on the receipt‑detail view is not rendered with a visible label (step 25 of the UI flow timed out), preventing users from accessing receipt history. In addition, a few secondary specifications are missing: the global offline banner, the full‑screen error view with a Retry button on the PolicyGate screen, and the loading indicator with copy "Reading file…" on the VerifyExport screen. Minor focus‑visible styling is also absent on some interactive components. These issues must be fixed before the product can be considered polished.

findings.issue: The "History" button is not present or not rendered with a visible label (icon + label). UI‑flow automation cannot locate it, breaking the primary "View History" step.
findings.fix: Add a button with the visible text "History" (e.g., <TextButton mode="text" icon="history" >History</TextButton>) in the receipt detail screen, ensure it uses the PrimaryButton/TextButton component so design tokens and touch‑target sizes are applied, and wire it to navigate to ReceiptHistoryScreen. Provide an accessibilityLabel and make the label visible to screen readers.

findings.issue: The error state specified in DESIGN.md (full‑screen error view with copy “Unable to store your acceptance. Please try again.” and a visible “Retry” button) is missing or not accessible.
findings.fix: Implement an error UI that displays the error copy and a PrimaryButton labeled "Retry" that retries the policy acceptance. Ensure the button meets the 44 × 44 dp touch target, has focus‑visible styling, and is announced to screen readers.

findings.issue: The required full‑width offline banner (“You are offline. Some actions require an internet connection.”) is not included on any screen.
findings.fix: Create an OfflineBanner component that renders a full‑width view with the specified copy and appropriate background color from the theme, and embed it in the global Screen container so it appears on every screen when the app detects offline status.

findings.issue: The loading state when reading a CSV file (ActivityIndicator with copy “Reading file…”) is not shown, so users receive no feedback while the file is processed.
findings.fix: During CSV processing, render an ActivityIndicator with the label “Reading file…” (using the theme’s color and spacing), and ensure the label is visible to screen readers (announceForAccessibility).

findings.issue: Focus‑visible outlines (2 dp outline using theme.colors.outline) are not styled for buttons, violating the accessibility requirement for visible focus.
findings.fix: Add a style for the focus‑visible state of PrimaryButton (and TextButton, MiniFAB, etc.) that draws a 2 dp outline in the color defined by theme.colors.outline, and ensure the outline appears when the button receives keyboard focus.

findings.issue: The 'Accept' button is disabled until the checkbox is checked, which is correct behavior, but the disabled state could be more visually distinct (e.g., lighter opacity, different border) to reinforce it's not interactive.
findings.fix: Apply a more pronounced disabled state to the button (e.g., 30% opacity, grey border) to make it visually clear it's inactive.

findings.issue: The checkbox is positioned slightly to the left of the text, creating a slight visual misalignment with the text block.
findings.fix: Center-align the checkbox with the text it precedes, or add a small left padding to the checkbox container to improve alignment.

findings.issue: The 'Add receipt' button is visually emphasized with a darker shade and rounded corners, but the 'Receipt' and 'Mileage' buttons lack visual distinction from each other and from the primary action, reducing visual hierarchy.
findings.fix: Apply a subtle visual hierarchy to the secondary buttons: use a lighter shade or smaller size, or add a subtle border to differentiate them from the primary action.

findings.issue: The 'Receipt' and 'Mileage' buttons are spaced too closely together on desktop, creating a cramped appearance.
findings.fix: Increase the horizontal spacing between the 'Receipt' and 'Mileage' buttons on desktop to improve readability and visual breathing room.

findings.issue: visual quality 7/10 on 'dashboard_empty' (target 8+, minimum 7): Polished, modern, and functional empty state with clear hierarchy and consistent spacing. The primary action is obvious, typography is readable, and layout is clean. Minor spacing inconsistencies and lack of visual hierarchy in secondary buttons are the only areas for improvement.
findings.fix: Address this screen's findings until it looks polished and professional.

findings.issue: The primary action (Add receipt) is not visible on this screen; it's only shown in the empty state. The screen currently shows a populated state with one receipt card, but no explicit primary action button for adding new items.
findings.fix: Add a prominent 'Add receipt' button or gesture (e.g., floating action button) to the populated state to maintain consistent primary action visibility.

findings.issue: The card is centered on the desktop view, but there's no clear visual hierarchy indicating which elements are most important. The title 'Receipts' is at the top, but the card below it is not visually emphasized relative to the title or the bottom navigation.
findings.fix: Add subtle visual hierarchy to the card (e.g., bolding the amount, using a larger font for the title, or adding a subtle shadow) to guide the user's eye to the most important information.

findings.issue: The card has generous padding and spacing, but the text within the card (Date, Category, Notes) is not visually grouped or separated. The 'Office supplies' note is indented but not clearly demarcated from the category line.
findings.fix: Use subtle visual grouping (e.g., a thin divider line, or a slightly different font weight) to separate the 'Office supplies' note from the 'Category' line to improve readability.

findings.issue: visual quality 7/10 on 'receipts_loaded' (target 8+, minimum 7): Polished, clean layout with clear visual hierarchy and consistent spacing. The card design is modern and well-aligned. Typography is readable and scaled appropriately. Navigation is intuitive with a persistent bottom tab bar. No major usability issues. Could benefit from more visual polish and richer interaction cues.
findings.fix: Address this screen's findings until it looks polished and professional.
